newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks marginally firmer in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks marginally firmer in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks traded marginally firmer in early morning trade on Friday.
Investor demand remained firm, while the yen's surge against the dollar overnight prompted profit-taking in major export-oriented issues, brokers said.
After 12 minutes of trade, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 17.80 points or 0.09 percent at 20,079.61. June Nikkei futures stood 40 points higher at 20,100.
